meta.title: LEARNING TO COOK & MAKE COFFEE IN HOI AN | Vietnam | South East Asia Diaries #16
meta.description:
Looking for the best things to do in Hoi An, Vietnam? 🇻🇳
In this travel vlog we spend 2 days in Hoi An trying some of the most popular experiences including a Vietnamese cooking class, a traditional coffee making class, visiting a local market, and riding the famous basket boats!

If you’re planning a trip to Hoi An and wondering what tours are actually worth it, we show our full honest experience so you can decide if you should add these to your Vietnam itinerary.

What we did in Hoi An:
☕ Vietnamese coffee making class
🍜 Traditional Vietnamese cooking class
🛶 Basket boat ride experience
🥬 Local market tour
🇻🇳 Exploring Hoi An
